canonical_name: Internet Control Message Protocol — RFC 792 / STD 5 core

standardized.notes: RFC 792 remains STD 5 / Internet Standard with later updates.

last_known_use.notes: Core ICMPv4 message roles remain deployed.

addressing: ICMP messages are carried within IPv4 and refer to IP-layer processing state rather than introducing an independent address architecture.
routing_or_forwarding: No independent routing plane; generated/consumed by hosts and routers in connection with IP processing.
error_control: Reports selected errors and control conditions; does not make IP reliable.
flow_or_congestion_control: Historical control messages existed, but modern congestion control is not reducible to ICMP.

survival.provenance_notes: Echo and Time Exceeded semantics remain visible in current diagnostics.

open_questions: Trace Redirect and Source Quench operational history separately.
Connect ICMP primitives to ping/traceroute implementation artifacts without conflating protocol and tool.

sources.locator: RFC Editor metadata; RFC 792 message definitions

notes: Long-lived protocol primitive; diagnostic applications such as ping and traceroute are separate implementation artifacts built from ICMP/IP behavior.
